methodologyNotes: 15 notable air purifiers selected as the 2026 buyer comparison set, spanning small-room budget units, mid-range smart purifiers, large-room workhorses, premium/medical-grade models, and the latest 2025-2026 releases. Seeds from the brief (Coway Airmega 200M / AP-1512HH, Levoit Core 400S / Vital 200S, Blueair Blue Pure 211i Max, Dyson Purifier Cool, Winix 5500-2, Molekule Air Pro) were evaluated. The Winix 5500-2 appears discontinued on winixamerica.com as of June 2026 — replaced with the Winix 5520, which carries identical CADR specs per AHAM certification and the same technology stack. The Dyson Purifier Cool TP07 is no longer listed on dyson.com; replaced with the Dyson HushJet Compact and Dyson Purifier Big+Quiet BP04, which are Dyson's current US flagship purifiers. Coway AP-1512HH / Airmega 200M is discontinued on coway-usa.com (current US lineup focuses on Noble/Ultra/Slim rental models); included as a legacy reference unit with specs from independent review corroboration. Blueair 211i Max CADR corroborated via Energy Star database (model 3613111100 at 687 sq ft matches the 211i Max's 674 sq ft primary coverage; CADR dust 457/smoke 443/pollen 450 cfm). Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (levoit.com, blueair.com, winixamerica.com, dyson.com, molekule.com, rabbitair.com) and Energy Star API (data.energystar.gov). Key fallback: breathequality.com for Coway AP-1512HH and Winix 5520 third-party spec summaries. specKeys chosen for real comparability across all 15 units: cadr_smoke_cfm (AHAM-certified smoke CADR in cfm; most universally published), coverage_sqft (AHAM or manufacturer primary coverage in sq ft), hepa (true HEPA or HyperHEPA filter present, boolean; HEPASilent counted as true), filter_type (short string describing the filtration technology stack), noise_db_min (minimum fan speed noise in dB), smart (WiFi/app-connected, boolean), energy_star (Energy Star certified, boolean), release (YYYY or YYYY-MM). cadr_smoke_cfm: Dyson and Blueair do not publish CADR by model — those are null (confirmed absence from product pages, not an omission). priceUsd = US MSRP or current list price in USD as of 2026-06-15. accessedAt 2026-06-15 on all entries.
